A '''Tandem flight computer''' was a component used in [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]] such as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. It was manufactured by [[Torplex/Legends|Torplex]].
